 Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 17:26 GMT 17:26 GMT 
 HT: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Liverpool have had 28 touches in the opposition box so far today, the most on record (since 2008-09) by any side in the first half of a Premier League game against Arsenal.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:26 GMT 17:26 GMT 
 HT: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Did Jurrien Timber get away with one with the shirt pull on Alexander Isak?
 VAR said everything was fine but the Arsenal man had a fistful of the top. 
 4 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:25 GMT 17:25 GMT 
 HT: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 The atmosphere here is the best I've heard it in years.
 94 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Great half of football published at 17:23 GMT 17:23 GMT 
 HT: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 Great half of football. Andoni Iraola will be furious that his side aren't level and that Liverpool haven't had a penalty. As for Mikel Arteta, he won't want to see his Arsenal side get dominated like that again. 
 236 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:20 GMT 17:20 GMT 
 HT: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Liverpool's 19 crosses are the joint-most of any team in the first half of a Premier League match this season along with Tottenham 19 against Crystal Palace in October.
 46.5% of their attacking play has come down the left, with 36% in the middle and just 17.5% down the right.
 Bradley Barcola has been a busy bee!
 381 135 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 17:19 GMT 17:19 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal lead 1-0 at the break and I've no idea how. 
 What a first half of football that was. 
 889 265 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:18 GMT 17:18 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 [The scoreline] doesn't tell the full story. Liverpool should be level from Alexis Mac Allister's opportunities but they've created other chances as well.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 635 500 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 45+3 mins 45+3 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Bradley Barcola is the first to be shown a yellow card and it's most likely for his reaction to the referee giving a foul against him. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 541 420 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+2 mins 45+2 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal come forward for a rare attack as Declan Rice's shot spins off Ronald Araujo. 
 407 196 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 45+1 mins 45+1 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 We're now into two minutes of added time. 
 283 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 44 mins 44 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Apart from the first 15 minutes, Liverpool have been outstanding here but can't find the back of the net. 
 Arsenal look a bit shellshocked. 
 1064 460 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:14 GMT 17:14 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Do not understand how Arsenal have gone from looking so good to looking so clueless since taking the lead. Failure to push their advantage has cost them before, see it happening again here.
 George 
 1089 432 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Oh, Alexis Mac Allister has got to bury that.
 It's a beauty of a ball in from Milos Kerkez and you're waiting for Mac Allister to plant his header in the back of the net but he puts it over. 
 664 326 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 41 mins 41 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Into the final five minutes of this first half and what a half it's been. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 514 69 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 What on earth is Florian Wirtz doing there?
 He ignores the run of Bradley Barcola and plays it to an Arsenal player inside instead. 
 505 485 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 40 mins 40 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 So close for Florian Wirtz!
 He aims the free-kick towards the far top corner and it rebounds back off the bar. 
 What a goal that would've been. 
 Image source, Reuters 
 1020 396 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:09 GMT 17:09 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This Arsenal back line is under so much pressure. Organisation is going to be key for them to not concede before half-time.
 484 159 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:09 GMT 17:09 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 For a team in transition, Liverpool look the real deal. A bit worrying for the rest of the Premier League, being so early in Iraola's tenure.
 David, Norwich

 Post published at 38 mins 38 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Alexander Isak does well to hold off Jurrien Timber and Kai Havertz before going down and winning the foul.
